name: Frisia Ornstein
original_name: フリジア・オルンシュタイン
source:
A female maou who rules over 1/3 of the netherworld. She is known as the "Raging Bull of the Netherworld".
She is hundreds of years old but when converted to human age she is essentially a woman in her mid 30's. She has a nice body with a plump ass and thighs and amazingly huge breast, she also has horns like a water buffalo.

Unlike most other demons she is able to store extraordinary amounts of magic in her body and this has allowed her to reign supreme in the netherworld, with a haughty and selfish personality matching her power. Yet at the same time she has a innocent side and hates being alone.

When it comes to sex she is uninhibited and is great at blowjobs and boobjobs, however she hasn't had sex in hundred of years and can't even remember her first time. Generally she is assertive and likes being in charge, but when the situation is reversed she becomes disordered and is like a different person.
